items.title: Rivers Named Head Coach for NC State Football
items.summary: RALEIGH, NC – NC State's McMurray Family Director of Athletics Boo Corrigan has announced that former Wolfpack quarterback Philip Rivers has been named the head coach for Wolfpack Football.
